clarification_before_new_range_reads.injection: Use the numeric fixed injection location rather than the inconsistent description of a dark training-selected location. Set its amplitude from the fixed location's actual echo. Apply the perturbation to focused pulse samples as specified in processing.injections.
clarification_before_new_range_reads.training: Use one training set, preceding the first test block, for both test blocks. Keep the pulse ID sets disjoint.
clarification_before_new_range_reads.look_coherence: Median across looks of absolute value of the tapered coherent sum divided by tapered sum of magnitudes.
clarification_before_new_range_reads.split_agreement: For each block, both odd-only and even-only fitted frequencies must be within one Rayleigh width of the full target frequency.
clarification_before_new_range_reads.amplitude_gate: The injection amplitude criterion compares the fitted amplitude against the deterministic sampled, tapered point-model answer. At these look widths the small taper attenuation may change the amplitude from 2.0 mm; also report the difference from 2.0 mm.

umbra_metadata_only_amendment.reason: The overlap guard rejected the nominal 12 ms Umbra training gap before reading any Umbra signal or analyzing any pass. The first Umbra look starts 20 ms before its center.
